findings.subject: MG-4.4-0076:kconfig:PM
findings.title: 4.4 migration guide (NXP): On Kinetis KE1xF, this overlay is also required when CONFIG_PM is enabled. (only in files this build doesn't use: sysbuild/mcuboot/prj.conf)

evidence.text: nxp,lptmr nodes used as the system timer must now be designated via the zephyr,system-timer chosen property. Boards based on i.MX95 and MCX-W SoCs already have this set in the SoC DTSI and require no change. All other boards using CONFIG_MCUX_LPTMR_TIMER must add a board overlay: / { chosen { zephyr,system-timer = &lptmr0; }; }; On Kinetis KE1xF, this overlay is also required when CONFIG_PM is enabled.

findings.subject: MG-4.4-0010:header:kernel.h
findings.title: 4.4 migration guide (Kernel): Heap hardening support has been implemented by adding a build time generated zephyr/heap_constants.h file that is now included from kernel.h.

evidence.text: Heap hardening support has been implemented by adding a build time generated zephyr/heap_constants.h file that is now included from kernel.h. This may create a build race condition for downstream application built as a cmake library where cmake may try to build them before the header file is generated, these may need an extra add_dependencies(${lib} zephyr_generated_headers) entry in cmake, see :github:`106439` for mode details.
